name: sup-platform
description: SUP — a real-time multiplayer workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sup/shared && npm run build -w @sup/server && npm run build -w @sup/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @sup/server" "npm run dev -w @sup/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @sup/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @sup/server && npm run typecheck -w @sup/web
